column1: # English for JP 1.27 (BCJS30089) message_text strings that have no US or Asia English.
# Used by tools/jp127_english.py. Columns: table:group:index <TAB> jp-hash <TAB> English.
# jp-hash is the first 16 hex digits of SHA-1 over the game's Japanese string (UTF-8 bytes), so
# no game text is stored here. A row applies only while the hash still matches the game string
# and the English keeps the same printf specifiers and button codes. Escapes: \n newline,
# \xNN control byte (\x07A..\x07@ colour, \x0bX button icon), \ backslash.
# Most rows are online-only features (Chip-in Golf lobby, Capsule Machine, tickets) whose
# servers are gone; they are translated so no Japanese is left if those screens are reached.

Welcome to the Chip-in Golf Lobby!
 
First, the \x07Arules\x07@.

Now, enjoy Chip-in Golf!

Basics 1
 
Q. I can't chip in.
 
A. Try \x07Ashort shots\x07@ from \x07Aflat
    ground on the fairway\x07@.
    Once you get the hang of it, go longer
    \x07Aand raise your Today's Total Score!

Basics 2
 
Q. Where can I see the rankings?
 
A. Press \x0bA \x07Anear the ranking board\x07@
    in the Chip-in Golf Lobby.

Basics 3
 
Q. What if I run out of balls?
 
A. Play a round in a \x07AReal Tournament\x07@
    to \x07Aearn balls\x07@!
    \x07AGood results\x07@ earn \x07Aextra\x07@ balls.
 
    \x07AYou earn even more balls
    playing as a rare character!

Basics 4
 
Q. What is the \x07ABest Score\x07@?
 
A. Your \x07Ascore for a chip-in\x07@ on the
    \x07Afirst of your 10 shots\x07@.
    See how high you can go
    \x07Aagainst everyone in the lobby!

Basics 5
 
Q. What is the Lie Bonus?
 
A. The lie is the ground and
    conditions under your ball.
    \x07AChipping in from a tough lie\x07@ like a
    \x07Abunker\x07@ or \x07Arough\x07@ \x07Ascores more\x07@!

Basics 6
 
Q. What are the red circles?
 
A. \x07ANo-shot areas\x07@. \x07AAfter a chip-in\x07@,
    \x07Ayou can't shoot from that spot again\x07@.
    When one appears, find a new spot
    and \x07Amove\x07@ there.

Basics 7
 
Q. What if I land in a bunker or pond?
 
A. \x07ABunkers\x07@ and \x07Aponds\x07@ give a \x07Apenalty\x07@:
    \x07Ayou lose balls.\x07@
    Your count can't go below zero,
    but try not to fall in...

Basics 8
 
Q. My pet cat disappeared!
 
A. So you can focus on Chip-in Golf,
    \x07Apets are not allowed\x07@ in this area.
    Thank you for understanding.

Advanced 1
 
Q. I can't clear the bunker in front.
 
A. After starting a shot, hold \x0bJ
    while setting power for \x07Abackspin\x07@.
    The ball \x07Aflies a bit higher\x07@,
    but \x07Ait wobbles more\x07@.
 
    \x07ARare characters wobble less!

Advanced 2
 
Q. The wind is too strong to chip in.
 
A. \x07ATry to\x07@ hit with a \x07Atailwind\x07@
     or into a \x07Aheadwind\x07@.
     Not sure which is which?
     \x07AAsk the players around you!

Advanced 3
 
Q. I can't sink shots from high-rated lies.
 
A. After starting a shot, hold \x0bH
    while setting power for \x07Atopspin\x07@
    to \x07Areduce wobble a little\x07@.
 
\x07A    The higher a rare character's rarity,
    the less the ball wobbles!

Advanced 4
 
Q. What is the Target Score?
 
A. \x07AReach a Target Score\x07@ to unlock
    more things to do in the lobby!
    \x07AWhat you unlock is a surprise!\x07@
    \x07ATarget Scores are never reset.

Advanced 5
 
Q. I want to improve fast.
 
A. \x07ACompete with players\x07@ in the
    same lobby and \x07Atrade tips on
    rare characters\x07@. It's the
    quickest way to get better!
    \x07APlease be polite online!

Advanced 6
 
Q. I want to be No. 1 in the rankings.
 
A. \x07ARare characters\x07@ from the
    Capsule Machine reduce wobble
    based on their rarity!
\x07@    \x07ABuy tickets, then use the Capsule
    Machine.\x07@ Get ahead of everyone!!
